use_case_name: Clear Exercise Surveillance Data on an Exercise Status Order

claims.content: The C2 JU clears exercise surveillance data by issuing an Exercise Status Order message that removes the Exercise Indicator and artificial data from exercise tracks.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU clears exercise surveillance data by issuing an Exercise Status Order message that removes the Exercise Indicator and artificial data from exercise tracks.

claims.content: C2 JU
There are tracks in the JU's database with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1.
The C2 JU issues a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to clear exercise surveillance data.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU issues a J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to clear exercise surveillance data.

claims.content: Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, all JUs automatically set the Identity Amplifying Descriptor to Exercise Friend for tracks with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1.
All JUs automatically set all data fields containing artificial information to the No Statement, default value, or actual values if held in database, and set the Exercise Indicator to value 0.
All JUs break any locally originated engagement involving the track number by transmitting a J10.2 (WES = 8) message to report the engagement broken.

All JUs terminate any locally originated Command message with Command values 2, 3, 5, or 7 involving the track number by transmitting a J9.0 message with the Command field set to value 4 (Cease Engage) or value 5 (Hold Fire) if the Engagement Status field is set to value 4 (Firing).
If a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, all subsequent messages received with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be discarded.

After receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, no messages with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be originated until local operator action is taken to reenable the JU to accept and originate exercise tracks.
After receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, all subsequent messages received with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be discarded.

After receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, no messages with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 shall be originated until local operator action is taken to reenable the JU to accept and originate exercise tracks.
All JUs have set the Identity Amplifying Descriptor to Exercise Friend for tracks that previously had the Exercise Indicator set to value 1.
All JUs have set all data fields containing artificial information to the No Statement, default value, or actual values if held in database, and have set the Exercise Indicator to value 0.
All JUs have broken any locally originated engagement involving the track number by transmitting a J10.2 (WES = 8) message.

All JUs have terminated any locally originated Command message with Command values 2, 3, 5, or 7 involving the track number by transmitting a J9.0 message with Command field set to value 4 (Cease Engage) or value 5 (Hold Fire) if Engagement Status is Firing.
All data fields set to No Statement or default values remain so set until operator action changes them or a remote report with Exercise Indicator set to value 0 is received.
All subsequent messages received with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 are discarded.
No messages with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 are originated until local operator action is taken to reenable the JU to accept and originate exercise tracks.
